comparison_reference.name: Fantasy UI Pack by Catau Games
comparison_reference.notes: Named commercial reference; visual comparison is limited to the current candidate and prior review evidence, and the reference pack itself was not directly inspected in this pass.

professional_quality.evidence: The wide rails and repeated small ornament read as a clean generic gold frame rather than richly ornate inventory art.
professional_quality.guidance: Compare finish against a named professional reference; explain remaining weaknesses.

readability.evidence: Twelve slots, selected slot and three button states are distinguishable at native resolution.
readability.guidance: Identify each subject at native resolution from silhouette and proportions.

pixel_clustering.evidence: At 3x the beveled rails, slot frames and buttons use contiguous clusters and consistent edges.
pixel_clustering.guidance: Inspect clusters for noise, isolated pixels, banding and accidental geometry.

color_and_lighting.evidence: Gold upper highlights and dark inner borders provide hierarchy; teal accents contrast with the warm frame.
color_and_lighting.guidance: Check palette harmony, volume, light direction and controlled contrast.

materials.evidence: The bevel suggests metal, but the broad flat rails and sparse specks do not convey elaborate metalwork.
materials.guidance: Explain how each material reads through its structure rather than generic pattern noise.

specialized_design.evidence: Separate normal, selected, hover and pressed components correspond to a usable inventory interaction vocabulary.
specialized_design.guidance: Check anatomy, architecture and characteristic features of the subject.

artistic_detail.evidence: The revised frame adds mitered corners and small glints, but the wide rails remain mostly empty and repeated.
artistic_detail.guidance: Assess depth, personality and finish beyond a merely acceptable primitive.

originality.evidence: The current pixels differ from the recorded prior rejection; the design retains a common panel and button vocabulary.
originality.guidance: Compare with prior and rejected work; explain new geometry and legitimate reuse.

consistency.evidence: The six exported components use consistent gold framing, outline and palette; button states remain visually related.
consistency.guidance: Compare scale, perspective, style and detail density within the intended catalog.

technical_integrity.evidence: The 192 by 132 transparent preview has one island, 26 colors and a 3 px margin. Six separate PNGs were inspected; each has one island and at least 1 px margin.
technical_integrity.guidance: Verify dimensions, transparency, borders, directions and absence of deformation.

game_readiness.evidence: Separate panel, slot and button PNGs and specs exist; the panel spec declares 12 px nine-slice margins, but actual resizing, state wiring and engine import have not been tested.
game_readiness.guidance: Verify complete views/states/animations and integration without manual repair.
